scenario: Cross-type temporal comparison rejection per LTIM.5.5. Comparing `Time` to `Date`, `Date` to `Duration`, etc., is a compile error. Authors convert explicitly via `t.date(tz)` or similar. Pin: `Time < Date` comparison rejects with DS_VALIDATE_TYPE_MISMATCH.
rules_ds:
schema Cmp scope logical:
    entity_id: String key
    fired_at: Time mutable
    target: Date mutable

rule trig:
    Cmp c where c.fired_at < c.target
->
    log info "x"
